behavior: dotf init lists and writes lint.yml for every stack, none included, and --dry-run lists it without writing
lint.yml triggers on the default branch, lints the forge's workflow directory, and an existing lint.yml in any forge directory is left untouched
the emitted lint.yml passes actionlint and scripts/check-actions-pinned.sh
verification: d=$(mktemp -d) && (cd cli && go build -o "$d/dotf" ./cmd/dotf) && (cd "$d" && ./dotf init . --stack none --skip-vault >/dev/null && actionlint -shellcheck=shellcheck .github/workflows/*.y*ml) && mkdir -p "$d/scripts" && cp scripts/check-actions-pinned.sh "$d/scripts/" && bash "$d/scripts/check-actions-pinned.sh"

behavior: a test fails when the template's actionlint version differs from versions.conf, or its checkout SHA from this repository's workflows
